# sendio_domains (Data Source)

Lists the team's sending domains, newest first.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sendio_domains" "all" {}

output "verified_domains" {
  value = [for d in data.sendio_domains.all.domains : d.name if d.status == "verified"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

### Nested Schema for `domains`

- `region` (String) Sending region.
- `status` (String) Verification status.
